description: A painted scene in heavy rain. A hooded young man in a black duffel coat walks toward the viewer, carrying an acoustic guitar and holding a round peace-symbol sign. Behind him, a long column of men in trench coats, flat caps and dark suits carries similar peace signs, and some hold umbrellas. The muddy, puddled path runs between bare trees under a dark, stormy sky. No visible text, frame or border.
